name: Data.Pair.norm_conj_intAlgPart_le
summary: Bound the squared norm of every conjugate of the trivial lift by the conjugate bound for jets, then the class sums by the number of classes, all within exp(x^34) by the scales.

steps.claim: Let X = trivialLift H.2 1, the lift at the trivial twist.

For every automorphism σ: the squared class-sum norm of the σ-conjugate of X is at most the number of classes times the square of a bound for the values (classSum_le_card_mul_sq); each value is a sum of conjugated jets (trivialLift_apply, sqrt_weylNormSq_sum_le), bounded by part (ii) of norm_jet_le_of_isAdmissibleComb for the indicator datum (isAdmissibleComb_vacuumDatum with M = 1), with the lift weight (LValueData.isLiftWeight), the size of the residue ring of the level modulus and the trivial weight (κ = 0, so the Weyl vector has norm 1: weylNormSq_weylEval_permArray).
steps.lean:
have k σ : X.normSqAt σ ≤ _ :=
    classSum_le_card_mul_sq fun _ ↦ by grw (transparency := default) [trivialLift_apply,
    sqrt_weylNormSq_sum_le, (P.norm_jet_le_of_isAdmissibleComb (hb := b_hasWeight _)
    (P.isAdmissibleComb_vacuumDatum 1 (by grind [levelIndicator, norm_one, norm_zero])) ..).2 1
    (LValueData.isLiftWeight _), Fintype.card_fun, card_levelModulus_resRing, prod_q_chosenPlace,
    prod_eq_one _ nofun, (by aesop : AuxPair.κ _ = 0), (congrArg _ (by simp [_root_.funext_iff,
    weylEval, nablaBasis_eq_one])).trans (weylNormSq_weylEval_permArray (rowPos _))]

steps.claim: |σ⟨X, X⟩| ≤ (norm of the conjugate of X)² (norm_map_inner_le).
Unfold intAlgPart at the trivial twist (twist_one_spec) and the diagram weights in all hypotheses.
steps.lean: simp [intAlgPart, twist_one_spec, diagramWeight, ← card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_pi] at *

steps.claim: Chain the bounds: step 3, step 2 twice, and bound the numbers of classes at the chosen level and at the level of the pair by exponentials (card_stdClasses_le_exp, with the levels compared by principalLevel_le_chosenLevel and principalLevel_le_levelOf); pass to logarithms.
steps.lean:
grw [this, k, k, mul_self_sqrt (by bound),
    D.card_stdClasses_le_exp (D.principalLevel_le_chosenLevel ⟨_, rfl⟩), prod_eq_one _ nofun,
    D.card_stdClasses_le_exp (principalLevel_le_levelOf (·.rec (mul_mem_right _ _ ·.2.2.1) nofun))
    (H.2.1 ▸ D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound), ← le_exp_of_log_le]

steps.claim: The resulting inequality of logarithms (with denomBound and |n| = 2z) holds on the scales (le_of_hasLogBound).
steps.lean: simpa [denomBound, H, log_mul, NeZero.ne] using D.le_of_hasLogBound
